title: She Was 60, Armed, and Carrying the Mail.

brand.cta: Follow The Black History Room for one story a day.

beats.text: She was sixty, armed, and carrying the mail.

overlays.hook: She was 60, armed, *and carrying the mail.*

beats.text: Born enslaved in Tennessee around 1832, freed after the Civil War.
She kept the grounds at a convent in Toledo. God help anyone who walked on her lawn, a nun said.
In 1885, she went to Montana to nurse a sick nun, and stayed on at the mission.
She drank, she cursed, and she faced down an armed man. The bishop threw her out.

visual.title: Thrown out
visual.caption: Mother Amadeus and the Ursulines of St. Peter's Mission, 1897

beats.text: So in 1895, in her sixties, she won a U.S. mail contract, the first Black woman ever to.
Her route ran from Cascade to the mission. She carried a gun.
When the snow was too deep for horses, she put on snowshoes and carried the sacks herself.
Eight years. She never missed a day.
She retired, opened a laundry, and drank in the saloons of Cascade, which celebrated her.

visual.title: Cascade
visual.sub: laundry, saloons, and a town that loved her

beats.text: Mary Fields died in 1914, at about 82. The armed woman who carried the mail.

facts.claim: Born enslaved in Tennessee, 1832 or 1833; emancipated around 1863 / after the Civil War.
Groundskeeper at the Ursuline convent in Toledo, Ohio; the nun's lawn remark.
Went to St. Peter's Mission, Montana, in 1885 to nurse Mother Amadeus; stayed and did heavy work / hauling.
The bishop barred her from the mission (c. 1894) after complaints about drinking, cursing and an armed standoff with a man.
1895 star route contract, Cascade to St. Peter's Mission; first African American woman star route carrier; aged about 60-63.
She carried firearms on the route.
Used snowshoes and carried the mail on foot when snow was too deep.
Eight years (two four-year contracts, 1895-1903) without missing a day.
Ran a laundry from her home afterwards; drank in Cascade's saloons; the town celebrated her.
Died 1914 (Great Falls hospital, buried at Cascade), aged about 82.
